data.name: Julieta
data.gender_notes: Julieta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin name Julius which means 'downy-headed' or 'youthful'. This name is derived from the Roman god Jupiter. The name Julieta carries the meaning “Soft, tender, youthful, downy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Julieta usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, tender, youthful, downy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Julieta total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

Ultimately, the name Julieta embodies the divine qualities of the Roman god Jupiter and the gentle nature of a newborn, making it a beautiful and significant name for a Christian girl.
